extension_rule: Additional worker counts (12, 16) or batch sizes (32, 64) may be tested ONLY if every prior stage completed without OOM or integrity failure AND the predeclared cost rule holds: projected additional benchmark time <= 25% of remaining authorized runtime after reserving the affordability-gate calibration budget. No open-ended search.
stop_rules: stop immediately on any OOM (larger configurations are not attempted)
stop immediately on any integrity failure
stop launching new stages at 95% budget consumption (watchdog)
each stage runs the full validation corpus exactly once; no cherry-picking
note: This order was frozen during local software construction, before any provider or instance was chosen. It must not be reordered on the B200.
